name: List jobs
description: Lists the jobs of the user you act for, newest first: what ran, who started it, when, and how it ended, without inputs or results. Use it to see what happened over a period: since and until bound the time, status and caller narrow it, and next pages further back. Read-only operations, such as reading data, leave no job, so they never appear here. Needs crud/read on the user's jobs (j).

since.description: Only jobs created at or after this time: ISO-8601, such as 2026-11-21T09:00:00Z, or epoch milliseconds.

until.description: Only jobs created before this time, in the same forms.

status.description: Only jobs with this status, or one of these: PENDING, STARTED, PAUSED, INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED, COMPLETE, FAILED, TIMEOUT, REJECTED, CANCELLED.

caller.description: Only jobs this principal started, a DID; jobs of principals under it, such as its agents, count too.

before.description: Only jobs older than this job id: the next value of the previous page.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 50 by default.

jobs.description: Newest first, each with id, created, updated, name, operation, status, caller, and where they apply agent, session, parent (the job it ran inside), error (shortened) and tokens.

inRange.description: How many jobs the time range holds, before status and caller narrow it.

next.description: Present when there are more: pass it as before for the next page.
